servinfosub.title: Description
servinfosub.ptxt: ECM monitors conditions of the system components and circuits. When an abnormal condition in the system occurs, the ECM performs necessary controls as follows.

servinfosub.title: Self-Diagnosis Function
servinfosub.ptxt: ECM has self-diagnosis function that stores DTC for abnormalities detected in ENG A-STOP system. Stored DTCs remain in memory of ECM unless they are cleared.

servinfosub.title: Warning Function
servinfosub.ptxt: When a malfunction is detected in ECM, the ECM blinks on ENG A-STOP warning light (1) to warn the driver. The warning light is turned off when normal condition is detected.

servinfosub.title: Fail-Safe Control
servinfosub.ptxt: ECM performs fail-safe control when an abnormal condition related to ENG A-STOP system is detected and stops all control to protect the system.
Details of fail-safe control vary with detected DTC.
